identity.name: Svarog
identity.description: A thermogenic muscle-densifying agent originally developed by TerraGroup Labs for heavy-duty logistical personnel. Scavs have dubbed it 'Svarog's Anvil' due to the intense, furnace-like fever it induces. SVR-G temporarily reforges the user's muscular and vascular systems. It grants immense, untiring strength to haul heavy loads and work without exhaustion.
